en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a riverside town dominated by a large hilltop castle complex with a round defensive tower and steep‑roofed buildings, as well as a tall church spire. Below the hill are smaller townhouses and a waterfront with moored boats on a broad river. Decorative red script at the bottom identifies the scene, and smaller printed text appears along the left margin and bottom edge.
